stories.title: 3-Day Outlook
stories.description: Sunny skies and warm temperatures for one more day. Then, a cold front and increasing cloud cover will bring cooler temperatures for Tuesday ahead of a low pressure system that could bring the first mountain snow for our area on Wednesday. At least a couple inches of snow accumulation are becoming increasingly likely at the highest mountain pass elevations, with some dustings in the valleys. Be prepared to exercise extra caution if traveling to the mountains on Wednesday, as roads may become slick.
stories.altText: Temperature and weather outlook for the plains and mountains over the a photo backdrop of a blue sky and snowy tree. Sunny conditions expected Monday with cloud cover and cooler temperatures arriving by Tuesday, with 60s for low elevations, and 40-50s in the mountains. Mountain snow will begin late Tuesday night and continue into Wednesday, as temperatures remain in the 30s. For the plains, rain and temperatures in the in the 40s and 50s expected on Wednesday.
